title: Amateur hacker reportedly used AI to steal data of more than one million people in 82 Flemish municipalities, per VRT report relayed by Hungarian outlets
date_note: The relayed VRT report was published on 2026-11-25; the attacks are reported as running from 6 to 15 November.
geo_basis: Flemish municipalities, as the report states
summary: Hungarian outlets hir.ma and bumm.sk, relaying a report by Flemish broadcaster VRT (via the Hungarian news agency MTI), say an amateur hacker using the alias BabidiGhost stole data of more than one million people in 82 Flemish municipalities between 6 and 15 November. The reports say the attacker reached a service provider's poorly protected server and used an AI assistant to write code. The VRT original was not read.
plain: Hungarian outlets relaying a VRT report say an amateur hacker used AI to steal data of more than one million people in 82 Flemish municipalities via a service provider's server. The VRT original was not read.
exec: A relayed VRT report says a low-skilled attacker using AI reached data of more than one million people in 82 Flemish municipalities through a service provider's server.

evidence.quote: 82 flandriai önkormányzat 1,2 millió lakosának adatait lopta el
Több mint egymillió belga állampolgár személyes adatait lopta el egy amatőr hekker

validation.note: hir.ma and bumm.sk both relay one VRT/MTI report, so they count as one source. The VRT original and 24.hu could not be read or found; no official statement read.

review.note: Compared title, 82 municipalities, 1.2 million, 6-15 Nov, alias, provider server, AI claim and evidence quotes against hir.ma and bumm.sk; single_source correct
